title: Daily data job reports success for old history and failed markets
rootCause: Returned daily history was counted as current coverage; stale-tail retries stopped after older bars arrived. Future dates satisfied freshness and main swallowed failures with process exit zero.
fix: Check exact expected closed-session coverage, exclude later sessions, retry actual stale symbols and return nonzero for partial/failed/unsupported jobs; prioritize personal/managed disabled holdings and use the shared notified holiday list.
acceptance: Older/future history never replaces the target session; incomplete jobs fail visibly without deleting useful data; held disabled names retain priority.
